audit_items.proof_trace: Mutual exclusion between debt and collateral is fully maintained by two symmetric guards: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) aborts if a debt entry already exists, and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124) aborts if collateral already exists on the first (and only) debt-creating call. The subsequent-borrow branch (L136) skips the collateral check but can only be reached when a debt entry is already present — and a debt entry can only be created through the first-borrow path, which already verified collateral absence. The only insertion point for debt entries (`wit_table::add` at L126) is inside this guarded branch, so the invariant is structurally unbreakable.
